hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A k-digit positive number has value between 10^(k - 1) and 10^k - 1 inclusive.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Determine the overlap interval between the given range and the k-digit number span.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Use the arithmetic progression formula to sum the range modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def sumKDigitNumbers(low: int, high: int, k: int) -> int:
    MOD = 1_000_000_007
    k_min = 10 ** (k - 1)
    k_max = 10 ** k - 1
    start = max(low, k_min)
    end = min(high, k_max)
    if start > end:
        return 0
    count = end - start + 1
    total = (start + end) * count // 2
    return total % MOD
```
